parameter: EIA 1.4 Air: CEMS per EN 14181 with on-line reporting
remarks: ALP-EPC-00CQA-IC-SPC-0001 (CEMS specification); ALP-EPC-00CQA-IC-TRP-0001 (QAL1, QAL2 and AST reports); ALP-EPC-00CQA-CM-CMP-0001; permit PMT-017.
value_text: One CEMS per HRSG stack, QAL1-certified analysers, QAL2 calibration and annual surveillance (AST) per the standard cited in reference REF-CONS-0084; data logger with the on-line emission data link to the authority (permit PMT-017) and to the Owner; CEMS scope covers NOx, CO, NH3, O2 and flow, plus SO2 and dust for LDO firing.
